notes.text: An adventure, not a shooter: every input point is a still with 2-7 CHOICE buttons. A choice sets g[0] to a scene code and LinkTailPGC; the region PGC's POST either leaves the region (JumpVTS_PTT) or calls the VMGM dispatcher (PGC 4), whose PRE sends g[0] to the scene. No rnd.
notes.why: So a 'shot model' does not apply; the disc is mapped as a choice graph (tools/choice_graph.py) and played by route scripts.

notes.text: Power-on is an attract loop: VMGM 23 (5 s logo) -> 8 (4 s) -> 9 (31 s) -> 10, whose cell commands loop back to 9 unless a button is pressed.
notes.why: nav_offline's trace_nav park rule never parks in a two-PGC loop; choice_graph uses Player.run(park_on_buttons=True).

notes.text: Choice-graph states include all 16 GPRMs: inventory and progress live there, so one scene with different items is a different node. The VMGM options/title menus alone account for many states.
notes.why: Keep the graph honest about game state; cap with --max-nodes.

explore.description: Start the disc and walk its default path for 5 minutes (explore); then tools/hil_disc.py explored <run dir>

into_vts2.description: Replay the model's shortest route from power-on into the first region (VTS 2): six presses through the attract loop, the main menu (one Up to b1) and VTS 1. Proves the offline choice graph matches the rig.
